title: Visual direction (proposal hoac direction da promote)
description: Mot schema cho ca proposal (lab xuat, status <= CANDIDATE) va direction vN (PO promote theo section). Importer chi nhap section APPROVED. Xem workflow/visual-direction.md.

project.description: id project (vd block-home). Khong dung lam prefix schema.

version.description: 0 = proposal chua promote; promote-direction.ps1 tang +1 moi lan.

source.description: lab/tool da xuat file (duong dan tuong doi repo).

proposal.description: direction vN: proposal nguon cua lan promote gan nhat.

supersedes.description: direction vN-1 ma ban nay thay the.

referenceLevel.description: level tham chieu cho capture vong giua (level dong nhat, khong phai dep nhat).

intent.description: Visual intent: vai cau + dieu da khoa. So chinh xac nam o sections.*.values.

sections.description: Thuong gap: look, motion, fx. Moi section promote rieng (vd Look khoa truoc, Motion/FX sau).

profileMap.description: key trong values -> 'TenAsset.field.path' (SerializedProperty path). 'Mesh.*' = brief cho Blender, khong import.

tolerance.description: Tolerance motion parity. Thieu => total 0.10 (ti le), peak 0.15 (ti le), tPeak 0.03 s, end 0.02.

legacy.description: Field cua schema cu giu lai khi migrate (chi de tham khao).

status.description: Lab/agent chi ghi DRAFT/CANDIDATE. APPROVED chi do promote-direction.ps1 ghi theo quyet dinh PO.

values.description: So / mau / enum da chot. Moi key phai co trong profileMap (khong map duoc => khong duoc co trong lab).

metrics.description: Section motion: target may-kiem-duoc cho motion parity, theo demo.
